name: PERFORMANCE SKYLINE
description: Executive business performance skyline: 2D/3D animated daily view with year guides, multi-measure selection, and Day Spotlight. Signed additive BW Live data, currency-aware KPIs, accessible high-contrast blue interface.

unitLabel.description: Display unit override (e.g. EUR). Leave empty to detect currency or unit from bound SAC measure metadata or formatted values.

palette.description: Executive blue palette: azure, ocean, frost, indigo, steel

measureLabel.description: Optional measure label override; blank uses SAC measure label (e.g. Gross Revenue)

feeds.description: One or more additive numeric measures (Revenue, Costs, Quantity), including signed values; do not bind percentages or ratios.
Daily Date Dimension (one date dimension, e.g. 0CALDAY)
